subject: Lumera go-live: activation ownership & scope stitch plan
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Daniels <avery@lumera.ai>, contracts@lumera.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Lumera go-live: activation ownership & scope stitch plan

Team —

Excited to confirm Lumera HealthTech is formally signed (Deal DL-2028-0421). High-level context below so CS can pick up operational planning:

- Product: Hosted API + Dedicated (reserved) for inference; initial model is rwd-instruct-7B-quant.
- Target go-live: 2028-07-02 (customer expects pilot traffic that day).
- Committed throughput: 600 rps during business hours, with 250 rps sustained baseline off-hours.
- Key SLOs: p95 latency < 180ms for 512-token context; daily ingestion for embeddings not exceeding 1M/day.

Attached: Lumera_SOW_v2.pdf (signed), Lumera_MVP_config.xlsx (initial config items).

Immediate asks for CS to enable a smooth activation:
1) Primary activation owner and secondary (for escalation)
2) Confirm kickoff slot: Wed 2028-06-14 10:00-11:00 PT (proposed) — 60m onboarding + environment checklist.
3) Preliminary riskiest-items list from tech intake (network, firewall egress rules, KMS access, allowed regions).
4) Any required docs for procurement/finance beyond SOW/DocuSign (copied contracts@lumera.ai).

Monica — can you step in as primary owner? Vanessa suggested as backup for operational handoffs. Ben and I can join the kickoff to walk product constraints and the rollout timeline.

Avery — welcome aboard — please confirm the kickoff slot or propose alternatives. We included a DocuSign confirmation link in related links for your records.

Thanks all,

— Mateo
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Lumera_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), Lumera_MVP_config.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Daniels <avery@lumera.ai>, contracts@lumera.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera go-live: activation ownership & scope stitch plan

Thanks Mateo — happy to take primary ownership. Quick clarifying items before I lock resources and the kickoff agenda:

1) Environments: We typically provision a staging cluster identical to prod for the pilot. Is staging covered under the committed capacity in the SOW, or does Lumera want a smaller staging footprint? (Lumera_MVP_config.xlsx indicates a single cluster but not staging sizing.)

2) KMS: The SOW references customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest. Avery — will you be using an existing AWS KMS key in your account or do you want Redwood-managed keys? We’ll need IAM permissions documented in advance.

3) Acceptance criteria — can we confirm the acceptance test set? I propose the following minimal list for go/no-go:
   - 5x concurrent flows hit p95<180ms for 512 tokens for 1 hour
   - Data retention policy confirmed (default 30d unless otherwise specified)
   - Runbook for incident escalation and fallback policy (model variant fallback) reviewed

4) DocuSign: I’ll wait for confirmation that contracts@lumera.ai sees the fully executed SOW (we have a signed copy attached but want the system-of-record).

If the kickoff is 2028-06-14 10:00 PT that works for me — I’ll book a 60-minute slot and include the standard Activation Checklist, Network Readiness, and Preflight Acceptance run through.

Action: Mateo — can you add the HubSpot deal link and Lumera's internal tech contact (if different from Avery) so I can include them on the invite?

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Activation
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Daniels <avery@lumera.ai>, contracts@lumera.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera go-live: activation ownership & scope stitch plan

Thanks Monica — perfect. A few clarifications and assignments:

- Staging footprint: Lumera confirmed they want a smaller staging cluster (30% of prod) for testing. I added a note in the attached config.
- KMS: Avery replied offline — they will provide an AWS KMS key in their account and granted a cross-account role. I’ve asked for the role ARN; Monica, we’ll need that by EOD Thursday 2028-06-14 so infra can validate.
- Acceptance criteria: Approved as listed by Monica. I added one more item: "Chatbot frontal tests" — run 2 scripted prompts across languages (EN/ES) to validate tokenization and model fallback.

Owner assignments (confirmed):
- Primary activation owner: Monica Patel (CS) — overall success + acceptance sign-off.
- Secondary/operations lead: Vanessa Ortiz (CS Ops) — infra handoffs, runbook, monitoring dashboards.
- Sales liaison: Ben Carter — commercial questions, billing clarifications.
- Executive escalation contact: Mateo Alvarez — strategic and SLA exceptions.

Kickoff: Wed 2028-06-14 10:00-11:00 PT — Monica to send invite.

Related links: HubSpot -> https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DP-421 (added)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc123-lumera (signed)
Drive folder with onboarding artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LumeraActivation

Notes on immediate blockers:
- Network egress: Lumera needs 3 IP ranges whitelisted for dedicated pool — Avery to confirm by EOD 2028-06-12.
- Data residency: Lumera requests logs retained in us-west region for 90 days; this requires a retention override in the console (approved by Mateo).

Monica/Vanessa — let me know if you want me to join the technical portion of the kickoff; I can take the first 15 minutes for context.

— Mateo

From: Avery Daniels <avery@lumera.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@lumera.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera go-live: activation ownership & scope stitch plan

Thanks everyone — confirming the kickoff for Wed 6/14 10:00 PT. A few quick items from our side:

- Network egress: confirmed — we’ll whitelist the three IP ranges by EOD today and share the CIDRs to contracts@lumera.ai and to Monica directly.
- KMS Role ARN: attaching the IAM role ARN in a separate email to Monica (security reasons).
- Staging sizing: agreed on 30% of prod — our infra lead Jamie will join the kickoff. Jamie's email: jamie.nguyen@lumera.ai.
- Acceptance test: we’re good with Monica’s checklist and the extra multilingual prompt tests. We request one extra hour of monitoring on day-1 post go-live (Redwood to keep a support channel open).

A note on billing: we received the SOW and the DocuSign link — contracts@lumera.ai will process the initial invoice on 6/20 pending bank details; Ben, please keep us posted if any further paperwork is needed.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Avery Daniels
Director, Platform Ops
Lumera HealthTech
avery@lumera.ai | +1 (206) 555-0102
